messages.subject: Pennine - Meridian facility, report on title required
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Credit have approved the £8.55m facility (60% LTV against £14.25m). We'll need your Certificate of Title in the CLLS form before drawdown, confirming clear title and flagging anything material. Can you send the report when ready?

Diane Croft, Pennine Business Bank plc

messages.subject: RE: Pennine - Meridian facility, report on title required
messages.plaintextBody:
Diane,

Report on Title attached, which doubles as our Certificate to the Bank. Title is good and marketable; the main points to note are the Unit 2 roof (covered by a £75k retention), an environmental indemnity policy we're arranging, and a public sewer on the eastern boundary. Subject to discharge of the seller's existing charge on completion, the Property is good security for a first legal mortgage.

James

--
James Osei
